column4: componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and these four tests need a real componentized Python guest: they check that a workflow which raises fails the run, that one which returns an {"error": ...} dictionary stays completed, what the failure's message says, and that the registered defer runs once -- none of which can be shown without executing one. Whole tests with no dialect arm, so the job's DSNs do not change the count. Measured on the Test MySQL job (run 40442494854, PR #3434 head 2e6a1f22): 'multi-db/mysql' has 4 skip(s) matching no ledger line, and these four are the ones that skipped by name. Re-derive by name: grep '"Action":"skip"' test-report.json | grep TestAPythonWorkflowThat. They run for real in scripts/docker/python-toolchain.Dockerfile, where the toolchain exists (measured there: all four pass). (cleat#3433)
